defect: Version1 rejected the actual newline decoded from the generated curl write-out JSON; its synthetic fixture incorrectly used literal backslash-n.
correction: Permit a newline only in write-out, which must exactly match the bounded completion footer with one final newline.
Continue rejecting CR/NUL in all string directives and newlines in headers and other string directives.
